Market today: Tech is still the main driver, especially with AI and memory chips getting a lot of buzz. Your concentrated tech/chip book is right in the thick of it.

Your holdings: SOXL is a big loser (-51.56%) and flagged for SELL/TRIM. SPAL is also down (-28.55%) and new, so watch it closely. Remember margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on Micron (news) and Oracle (news) as they relate to AI and chips.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your risk, especially with SOXL and SPAL, given your margin exposure.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged ETF given its significant loss and decay risk.
SPAL: Monitor this new leveraged ETF closely; its current drawdown is concerning.
NVDA: If it pulls back to the 1H order block (223.73-224.64), consider it for a potential entry if conviction is high.
